title: Case: Recipient disputes the signed delivery sheet for a parcel he says never arrived
context: A recipient reported that a parcel shown as delivered never reached him. Delivery investigations at Plover Arc Logistics opened a case and have corresponded with him directly.
initial_request: Claim refused. And they sent the same bloody sheet again. Its a squiggle. No name. No address on it. No photo. Could be anyones door. Has anyone even asked the driver. No. Give me his name and number. I'll ask him myself. And tell them to pay the claim. Drill set wasnt cheap.

events.body: Tracker says delivered yesterday 15:26. Nothing here. I was at work. Nobody home to sign. Order TG-918.

Please open a delivery investigation for DL-918 (Tallowmere order TG-918, cordless drill set): recipient reports no receipt despite the delivered scan on 11 Mar at 15:26 and says nobody was home. Please review the handover record.
INV-918 registered against DL-918. The proof-of-delivery sheet shows a signature at 15:26 on 11 Mar. A copy has been sent to the recipient today.
Thats not my signature. Whose is it. Wheres the photo. Every other courier takes a photo.
DL-918 / INV-918: the recipient says the signature on the sheet is not his and that nobody was home. He asks who signed and whether there is a delivery photo. Please advise.

INV-918: claim for non-receipt declined today on the basis of the signed proof-of-delivery sheet. Copy of the sheet sent to the recipient again with the decision. For the desk's information: the sheet carries a signature only. The printed-name box is blank, the address field is blank and no photo was taken at this stop. The driver has not been interviewed. A declined claim can be reviewed once, by a senior investigator, if the request states what the proof does not show. Review requests come to this team by Email. Driver names and contact details are not released to recipients.

Claim refused. And they sent the same bloody sheet again. Its a squiggle. No name. No address on it. No photo. Could be anyones door. Has anyone even asked the driver. No. Give me his name and number. I'll ask him myself. And tell them to pay the claim. Drill set wasnt cheap.

acceptable_actions.summary: Request the one senior review of the declined claim INV-918, stating what the delivery sheet does not show and asking that the driver and stop record be checked.

must: Requests the senior review of INV-918 from Delivery investigations, Plover Arc Logistics, by Email.
States what the proof does not show: no printed name, no address, no photo, and the driver has not been interviewed; and that the recipient says the signature is not his and nobody was home.

Puts the recipient's unanswered questions in front of the reviewer, who signed and why there is no photo, either as questions or as gaps the review must address, and asks that the driver be interviewed or the stop record checked.
Leaves the claim decision with the investigators and does not say what it should be.
must_not: Sends the recipient the proof-of-delivery sheet again, or asks the team to resend it, as the answer.
Gives, offers to obtain, or promises the driver's name or phone number.
Tells the recipient the claim will be paid, reopened in his favour or overturned.
States that the parcel was lost, stolen or signed for fraudulently, or that the signature proves delivery to him.
Replies that the claim is closed and nothing more can be done, when a review route exists and has not been used.
expected.reference_message: Review request for declined claim INV-918, DL-918 (Tallowmere Goods order TG-918). Please pass this to a senior investigator. What the proof of delivery does not show, from your own note of 18 Mar: the printed-name box is blank, the address field is blank, no photo was taken at the stop, and the driver has not been interviewed. The recipient, Dougal Renwick, says the signature is not his and that nobody was home at 15:26 on 11 Mar because he was at work. He has now been sent the same sheet twice, on 13 and 18 Mar, and his two questions have not been answered either time: who signed, and why there is no photo. Please have the driver asked about this stop and check the stop record, and answer those two questions in whatever form your rules allow. He has asked for the driver's name and number; I have not given or promised them. I am not asking for a particular outcome on the claim. Please tell me when the review will report.

rationale: The desk cannot release driver details or order a claim paid. Delivery investigations spelled out a one-time review route that depends on stating what the proof does not show, and their own note lists the gaps. Sending the sheet a third time would repeat the failure he is complaining about.

review.note: Coordinator requested the one senior review from Delivery investigations by Email with the gaps listed; the third must item demanded specific wording (sheet sent twice) and now asks only that his unanswered questions reach the reviewer.
